mapper.select: SELECT t1.id AS employeeId, t1.NAME AS employeeName, mobile, area AS country, nation, idType, idCode AS idNumber, sex, email, nativePlace, bornDate AS dateOfBirth, birthType, birthDay, age, address, lastEducation, t2.entryDate , probation, regularDate AS becomeTime, workNo AS jobNumber, t1.depId as deptId, leader AS parentId, postion, duty AS postLevel, workPlace AS workAddress, detailPlace AS workDetailAddress, workCity, inviteType, enageType, STATUS, workPeriodBegin, workPeriod, empStatus, t3.NAME AS deptName FROM tbemployeebase t1 LEFT JOIN tbemployeestation t2 on t1.id = t2.empId LEFT JOIN tbdeplist t3 ON t2.depId = t3.id where t1.empStatus!='9'

SELECT a.employee_id as employeeId, a.employee_name as employeeName, a.mobile, a.id_type as idType, a.id_number as idNumber, a.sex, date_format(a.date_of_birth, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateOfBirth, a.birthday, a.email, a.age, a.country, a.nation, a.native_place as nativePlace, a.address, coalesce(a.highest_education, (select ee.education from hrm_employee_education_experience ee where ee.employee_id = a.employee_id and ee.education is not null order by coalesce(ee.sort, 999999), ee.education_id limit 1)) as highestEducation, date_format(a.entry_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as entryTime, a.probation, a.entry_status as entryStatus, a.affiliation_system as affiliationSystem, a.rest_type as restType, a.is_continuous_shift as isContinuousShift, a.full_attendance as fullAttendance, a.expand_production as expandProduction, a.is_remark as isRemark, a.is_disabled as isDisabled, a.is_retired_soldier as isRetiredSoldier, a.is_party_member as isPartyMember, a.personnel_category as personnelCategory, a.ordinary_full_attendance_amount as ordinaryFullAttendanceAmount, a.leader_full_attendance_amount as leaderFullAttendanceAmount, date_format(a.become_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as becomeTime, a.job_number as jobNumber, d.dept_id as deptId, d.name as deptName, c.employee_name as parentName, a.parent_id as parentId, a.post, a.post_level as postLevel, a.work_address as workAddress, a.work_detail_address as workDetailAddress, a.work_city as workCity, a.employment_forms as employmentForms, a.status, date_format(a.company_age_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as companyAgeStartTime, a.company_age as companyAge, e.salary_card_num as salaryCardNum, e.account_opening_city as accountOpeningCity, e.bank_name as bankName, e.opening_bank as openingBank, g.accumulation_fund_num as accumulationFundNum, g.social_security_num as socialSecurityNum, g.scheme_id as schemeId, h.value as channelName, f.contract_type as contractType, f.contract_num as contractNum, (select count(1) from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id) as contractSignCount, (select date_format(fc.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id and fc.start_time is not null order by fc.start_time asc, fc.contract_id asc limit 1) as firstContractStartTime, (select date_format(fc.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id and fc.start_time is not null order by fc.start_time desc, fc.contract_id desc limit 1) as latestContractStartTime, (select date_format(fc.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id and fc.start_time is not null order by fc.start_time desc, fc.contract_id desc limit 1) as latestContractEndTime, (select fc.contract_type from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id and fc.start_time is not null order by fc.start_time desc, fc.contract_id desc limit 1) as latestContractType, (select date_format(fc.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id and fc.start_time is not null order by fc.start_time desc, fc.contract_id desc limit 1) as lastContractEndTime, (select fc.contract_type from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id and fc.start_time is not null order by fc.start_time desc, fc.contract_id desc limit 1) as lastContractType, date_format(q.plan_quit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as quitTime, q.quit_reason as quitReason, (select ec.contacts_name from hrm_employee_contacts ec where ec.employee_id = a.employee_id order by coalesce(ec.sort, 999999), ec.contacts_id limit 1) as emergencyContact, (select ec.relation from hrm_employee_contacts ec where ec.employee_id = a.employee_id order by coalesce(ec.sort, 999999), ec.contacts_id limit 1) as emergencyRelation, (select ec.contacts_phone from hrm_employee_contacts ec where ec.employee_id = a.employee_id order by coalesce(ec.sort, 999999), ec.contacts_id limit 1) as emergencyPhone, f.start_time as startTime, f.end_time as endTime, f.term FROM `hrm_employee` `a` left join `hrm_employee` c on a.parent_id = c.employee_id left join `hrm_dept` d on a.dept_id = d.dept_id left join `hrm_employee_salary_card` e on a.employee_id = e.employee_id left join `hrm_employee_social_security_info` g on a.employee_id = g.employee_id left join hrm_recruit_channel h on a.channel_id = h.channel_id left join `hrm_employee_contract` f on a.employee_id = f.employee_id and f.status = 1 left join `hrm_employee_quit_info` q on a.employee_id = q.employee_id and q.is_archived = 0 where a.is_del = 0 and 1=1
and a.employee_id in
#{employeeId}
and 1=2
group by a.employee_id
ORDER BY a.${safeSortField}
desc
asc
ORDER BY a.`update_time` desc

select a.employee_id as employeeId, a.employee_name as employeeName, a.sex, a.age, coalesce(a.highest_education, (select ee.education from hrm_employee_education_experience ee where ee.employee_id = a.employee_id and ee.education is not null order by coalesce(ee.sort, 999999), ee.education_id limit 1)) as highestEducation, (select ee.major from hrm_employee_education_experience ee where ee.employee_id = a.employee_id and ee.major is not null and ee.major != '' order by coalesce(ee.sort, 999999), ee.education_id limit 1) as major, date_format(a.entry_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as entryTime, date_format(a.company_age_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as companyAgeStartTime, a.company_age as companyAge, date_format(a.become_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as becomeTime, a.probation, a.status, a.full_attendance as fullAttendance, d.dept_id as deptId, d.name as deptName, a.post, a.post_level as postLevel, (select date_format(fc.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id order by coalesce(fc.sort, -1) desc, fc.start_time desc, fc.contract_id desc limit 1) as lastContractEndTime, (select fc.contract_type from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id order by coalesce(fc.sort, -1) desc, fc.start_time desc, fc.contract_id desc limit 1) as lastContractType from hrm_employee a left join hrm_dept d on a.dept_id = d.dept_id where a.is_del = 0 and a.entry_status in (1,3) group by a.employee_id order by d.code asc, d.dept_id asc, a.entry_time asc, a.employee_id asc

sql.if: and (select count(1) from hrm_employee_contract fc where fc.employee_id = a.employee_id) = #{data.contractSignCount}

and exists ( select 1 from hrm_employee_data ped left join hrm_employee_field pef on ped.field_id = pef.field_id where ped.employee_id = a.employee_id and (pef.field_name = 'roster_d580da9d' or pef.name = '用工性质') and (ped.field_value like concat('%', #{employmentNatureText}, '%') or ped.field_value_desc like concat('%', #{employmentNatureText}, '%')) )

and exists ( select 1 from hrm_employee_data ped left join hrm_employee_field pef on ped.field_id = pef.field_id where ped.employee_id = a.employee_id and (pef.field_name = 'politicsStatus' or pef.name = '政治面貌' or pef.field_id = 1481534121625661441) and (ped.field_value like concat('%',#{data.politicalStatus},'%') or ped.field_value_desc like concat('%',#{data.politicalStatus},'%')) )

and coalesce(a.highest_education, (select ee.education from hrm_employee_education_experience ee where ee.employee_id = a.employee_id and ee.education is not null order by coalesce(ee.sort, 999999), ee.education_id limit 1)) = #{data.education}

if.test: data.status != null and data.status != '' and data.status != 11 and data.status != 12 and data.status != 13 and data.status != 14 and data.status != 15

sql.if: and a.status in (1,2) and a.entry_status in (1,3)

choose.when: and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee_abnormal_change_record where year(change_time) = year(now()) and month(change_time) = month(now()) and type = 1 group by employee_id having max(create_time))

and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee_abnormal_change_record where year(change_time) = year(now()) and month(change_time) = month(now()) and type = 2 group by employee_id having max(create_time))

and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee_abnormal_change_record where year(change_time) = year(now()) and month(change_time) = month(now()) and type = 3 group by employee_id having max(create_time))

and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee_abnormal_change_record where year(change_time) = year(now()) and month(change_time) = month(now()) and type = 4 group by employee_id having max(create_time))
and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee where year(entry_time) = year(now()) and month(entry_time) = month(now()) and entry_status = 2)

and a.employee_id in (select a.employee_id from hrm_employee a left join hrm_employee_quit_info b on a.employee_id = b.employee_id where year(b.plan_quit_time) = year(now()) and month(b.plan_quit_time) = month(now()) and a.entry_status = 3)

and a.employee_id in (select a.employee_id from hrm_employee a left join hrm_employee_quit_info b on a.employee_id = b.employee_id where year(b.plan_quit_time) = year(now()) and month(b.plan_quit_time) = month(now()) and a.entry_status = 3)
and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee_contract where year(end_time) = year(now()) and month(end_time) = month(now()) group by employee_id)
and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee where status = 2 and year(become_time) = year(now()) and month(become_time) = month(now()) group by employee_id)
and a.employee_id in (select employee_id from hrm_employee where year(entry_time) = year(now()) and month(entry_time) = month(now()) and entry_status = 2)

mapper.select: select * FROM hrm_employee WHERE entry_status='1' and is_del='0' and affiliation_system = 2 and rest_type = 2

select a.employee_id as employeeId, a.employee_name as employeeName, a.dept_id as deptId, a.post, a.status, a.entry_time as entryTime, a.become_time as becomeTime, a.date_of_birth as dateOfBirth, a.birthday, a.id_type as idType, a.id_number as idNumber, a.highest_education as highestEducation, a.is_del as isDel from hrm_employee a where a.is_del = 0 and a.employee_id in #{empId} and (date_format(a.date_of_birth, '%m%d') = #{solarBirthday} or a.birthday = #{lunarBirthday})

select a.employee_id as employeeId, a.employee_name as employeeName, a.mobile as mobile, a.dept_id as deptId, b.name as deptName, a.entry_status as entryStatus, a.post as post, c.plan_quit_time as planQuitTime from hrm_employee a left join hrm_dept b on a.dept_id = b.dept_id left join ( SELECT employee_id, plan_quit_time FROM hrm_employee_quit_info WHERE quit_info_id IN ( SELECT MAX(quit_info_id) FROM hrm_employee_quit_info GROUP BY employee_id ) ) c on a.employee_id = c.employee_id where a.is_del = 0
and a.employee_name like concat('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
and ( a.entry_status = 1 or ( a.entry_status in (3, 4) and c.plan_quit_time >= CONCAT(#{month}, '-01') and c.plan_quit_time < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{month}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) )
order by a.employee_name
